row.notes: SafetyCarDeployment message handler (name kept for signatures.json; per verify-c it handles the whole message, not only the set). msg+0x18 = phase: 0 eDeployed - first message stores the deployment type byte +0x1c (1 = SC, 2 = VSC) in self+0x108, a later SC upgrades a running VSC (2 -> 1), self+0x109 = msg+0x1d; 3 eResumeRace - clears +0x108/+0x109. Every message is re-dispatched as bus msg vtable 0x1457e7840 with msg+8..+0x1f. 7+ callers in session states (0x142d5d45a, 0x142d6a61d, 0x142d6fc7f, 0x142dfb5b5, 0x143607e59, 0x143611222). (used by vmknolle session-watch)
